overview.text: She sponsored the PFAS Cleanup Act, which her office says would establish a tax on the manufacturing of PFAS chemicals to fund a tax credit for water agencies to remove them. In September 2026 she voted against a resolution to disapprove California’s harbor craft pollution standards. Her campaign says she is fighting to lower prices.
